evidence_items.publisher: arXiv; Ahmed Fawzy, Amjed Tahir and Kelly Blincoe
evidence_items.locator: Section 5.1, The Speed–Quality Trade-off Paradox; supporting analysis in Section 4.3
evidence_items.explanation: The researchers analyzed 101 practitioner sources containing 518 firsthand behavioral accounts. Their quality-perception analysis documents recognition of flawed outputs, production-readiness difficulties and maintenance costs, while also documenting continued enthusiasm and use.

unresolved_gaps: The self-selected accounts do not establish the proportion of all customers holding these beliefs.
The study does not measure a population-wide change in beliefs over time.
